description: Weighted anomaly-risk index with an evidence-first action table. Scores are anomaly/context indices, not fraud probabilities.

families.velocity: Unusually intense transfer velocity for this sender
families.amount_deviation: Material deviation from the sender's own recent amounts
families.compromised_access: Device or session change accompanied by recent authentication failures
families.beneficiary_risk: New beneficiary that other accounts started paying at the same time
families.funds_flow: Recently received funds being passed straight on to a new beneficiary
